rationale: The RFC Editor public-knowledge origin is approved for exact bounded historical archive profiling after migration to its www publisher host. Robots disallows three RFC subtrees; none is the approved homepage route. Archive evidence is never a current publisher statement.
constraints: Historical evidence must retain RFC Editor attribution and native lexical values.
No live content crawl, authentication, browser, model, payment, action or canon promotion is authorized.
Only the exact homepage route and two approved Common Crawl periods are permitted.
The scheduler remains disabled and archive evidence is not a current publisher statement.
